title: smart-dashboard
subHeroTitle: Six cards. One glance. Complete dashboard command.
subHeroDesc: The Dashboard Panel gives you a live workspace snapshot — a 3D wheel picker with six context cards, real-time stats, and a live clock that respects your time format preference. Scroll through top priorities and blocked queues instantly.

sections.title: A live workspace snapshot on a 3D wheel picker
sections.desc: Cycle through six dedicated cards summarizing your focus, blockers, replies, and upcoming events. Monitor real-time stats and capture tasks instantly without leaving your central view.

gridItems.title: Six Wheel Picker Cards
gridItems.desc: Cycle through Current Focus, Immediate Blockers, Needs Reply, Next Event, Quick Capture, and Up Next cards, each linking directly to relevant items.

gridItems.title: Real-Time Stats Row
gridItems.desc: Track urgent blockers (red), pending replies (blue), and today's task queue (green) updating in real-time alongside clock options.

gridItems.title: Live Clock Preference
gridItems.desc: A persistent dashboard clock displaying local time, automatically respecting your 12h or 24h format user settings.

gridItems.title: Instant Quick Capture
gridItems.desc: One-click task capture card on the wheel that opens quick-creation dialogs without leaving the main dashboard.

sections.title: Supervisor AI and autonomous agents command center
sections.desc: Interact with a master Supervisor AI agent that routes natural language commands to specialized sub-agents. Track chain-of-thought decision logs and file attachments with conversation memory.

gridItems.title: Master Supervisor Agent
gridItems.desc: A central AI coordinator routing complex requests to specialized agents for tasks, scheduling, and documentation workflows.

gridItems.title: Specialized Task & Schedule Agents
gridItems.desc: Create and search tasks using natural language, and let the AI scheduler auto-allocate unscheduled sprint items.

gridItems.title: GitHub & Dev Stack Tools
gridItems.desc: Integrate code repositories to list PRs, generate issues from tasks, and sync workflows in real-time.

gridItems.title: Chain-of-Thought & Exa Search
gridItems.desc: Track exact execution steps showing tool decisions, supplemented by live web searches via Exa API and PostgreSQL conversation memory.

capabilitiesDesc: Scroll the 3D wheel picker to cycle through your most important context — from today's top priority to messages waiting for your reply.
checklistTitle: Integrate your day in one workspace
checklistDesc: KeilHQ parses calendars, sprint files, and task logs to compose your optimal focus list automatically.
checklistItems: 3D Wheel Picker: Six scrollable context cards representing priorities, blockers, replies, quick captures, and upcoming sprint items.,
Supervisor AI Agent: Natural language command input routing queries to specialized agents for tasks, calendars, and documentation.,
Chain-of-Thought Logs: Real-time decision logs illustrating exactly how the AI processes and retrieves data for each command.,
Unread comments & replies: Automatic aggregation of pending replies, calendar updates, and urgent blockers updating in real-time.
